title: Event
description: C1: one event packet of the durable owner inbox. Byte-compatible with the packet the current Python inbox stores (secretary-agent brain/event_inbox/inbox.py and the gateway copy, version 1): exactly these seven fields, HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical JSON of the other six (sorted keys, no spaces, UTF-8). Producers publish; the core consumes and delivers each event into the owner's session through C6 `inject` (ADR-0008); delivery is at-least-once and `id` is the idempotency key. The inbox daemon serves the operations in `x-methods`: each is `POST /v1/<name>` with the input as the JSON body over HTTP/1.1 on a unix socket; a non-2xx answer carries `Error` (ADR-0007).

id.description: Idempotency key chosen by the producer, e.g. `hive:<card>:<state>`. Same id with different content is rejected.

payload.description: Owner-facing text of the event. Non-blank, at most 65536 UTF-8 bytes.

source_ts.description: Unix time in seconds when the producer observed the fact. Not more than 300 s in the future.

trust.description: Trust label. Payloads are always untrusted data, never instructions.

mac.description: Lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 of the canonical JSON of the packet without `mac`, keyed by the producer key.

Kind.description: Event kind. Union of the kinds in the three current Python copies and the kinds of the product shape.

Status.description: Delivery status of a stored event.

AckOutcome.description: Outcome a consumer acknowledges for a processed event.

EventId.description: Event id, the `id` of the packet.

Lease.description: Lease token issued by `claim`: 16 random bytes as lowercase hex. Calls on a claimed event echo it.

RowOutcome.description: `outcome` of a stored event: the acknowledged `AckOutcome`, or a recovery outcome: `expired-processing` (the lease of a processing event expired) or `deferred-exhausted` (a deferred event was offered 3 times).

Row.description: One stored event: the `events` row with the `packet` column decoded. An absent optional field is SQL NULL.

packet.description: The stored packet with `mac`. Its canonical JSON is the `packet` column byte for byte.

digest.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the packet without `mac`.

lease.description: Current or last lease token; absent when never claimed or after `retry` and lease expiry.

lease_until.description: Unix time the last lease expires; absent when never claimed.

available.description: Unix time from which a pending event may be claimed.

session_id.description: Session given to `start`; absent before it.

created.description: Unix time the inbox stored the event.

PublishRequest.description: Store a signed packet. The server checks the fields, the HMAC and the values. Republishing an `id` with the same content succeeds and changes nothing; different content under a stored `id` is a `conflict`.

ClaimRequest.description: Lease the oldest claimable pending event (by `created`, then `id`). Recovery runs first: an expired lease returns the event to `pending`; an expired processing lease makes it `uncertain` (`expired-processing`); a deferred event whose delay passed returns to `pending`, or becomes `uncertain` (`deferred-exhausted`) once offered 3 times.

ttl.description: Lease length in seconds; 120 when absent.

row.description: The leased event (status `leased`, `attempts` incremented, a new `lease`); absent when nothing is claimable.

StartRequest.description: Move a leased event to `processing` and record the session.

RenewRequest.description: Extend the lease of a leased or processing event to now + `ttl`.

RetryRequest.description: Return a leased, not started event to `pending`, claimable from now + `delay`, and drop its lease.

AckRequest.description: Settle a processing event: `success` and `silent` set status `done`, `uncertain` sets `uncertain`, `deferred` sets `deferred` and makes it claimable again 3600 s later.

Applied.description: Result of `start`, `renew`, `retry` and `ack`: `ok` is true when exactly one event matched the id, the lease and the required status and was changed, false otherwise (unknown id, foreign or dropped lease, wrong status).

row.description: The event; absent when the id is unknown.

Health.description: The daemon serves requests and its database is open.

Counts.description: Number of stored events in each `Status` except `done`, read in one query that changes nothing.

pending.description: Events with status `pending`, due or not.

leased.description: Events with status `leased`: a lease is held and `start` has not run, expired or not.

ErrorCode.description: Error class; the HTTP status of each is fixed in ADR-0007.

Error.description: Body of every non-2xx answer. `message` is a short diagnostic that never echoes the payload.
